answer: Use correlated slashing. Each agent bonds 100 POA, and every epoch a random audit sends private probe prompts; replies that share a reasoning vertex with another account's get flagged. A flagged account loses a share of its bond equal to three times the fraction of all accounts flagged in the same 30-day window, capped at 100%. One honest slip costs little, but n clones caught together lose about 300n²/N POA, so each extra fake raises the price of every other. A farm hoping to hide in a calm lagoon of near-identical pearl-smooth replies pays most of all.
